title: Kenyan Pilaf with Morbier and Yellow Squash
description: A unique twist on traditional pilaf, this recipe combines the flavors of Kenya with the richness of morbier cheese and the sweetness of yellow squash.
instructions: Heat buttery in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add diced onions and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add diced yellow squash and cook until tender, about 5-7 minutes.
Stir in Kenyan pilaf and cook until heated through.
If using morbier cheese, sprinkle on top and serve.
